title: MagMAX Plant DNA Isolation Kit Automation Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol automates the ThermoFischer MagMAX Plant DNA Isolation Kit on up to 192 samples (2 plates of 96). The entire workflow is broken into 2 different protocols. This is part 1, disrupting the tissue. In this protocol, 590µL of buffer (combination of 500µL lysis Buffer A, 70µL of Lysis Buffer B, and 20µL of RNase A) is added to each well. The user is then prompted to remove the plate(s) for off deck vortexing/shaking and incubation. Once incubation is complete, the user returns the plate(s) to the deck and the robot will add 130µL of the precipitation solution. After one final incubation off the robot and a spin down, 400µL of supernatant is transferred to a deep well plate. The 400µL sample can be stored or purified with part 2 of the protocol. steps.title: Prepare buffer mixture
steps.instruction: Combine 500 µL Lysis Buffer A, 70 µL Lysis Buffer B, and 20 µL RNase A to make a 590 µL buffer solution for each well.

steps.title: Add buffer to wells
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 with a p300 multi‑channel pipette, dispense 590 µL of the prepared buffer into each well of the sample plate (up to 192 samples, i.e., two 96‑well plates).

steps.title: Off‑deck vortex and incubate
steps.instruction: Remove the plate(s) from the robot, vortex or shake as required, then incubate for the time specified by the kit.

steps.title: Add precipitation solution
steps.instruction: Return the plate(s) to the robot; the robot adds 130 µL of precipitation solution to each well.

steps.title: Off‑deck incubation and spin
steps.instruction: Perform a final incubation off the robot (duration as directed by the kit), then centrifuge the plate(s) to spin down the precipitate.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to deep well plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 400 µL of cleared supernatant from each well to a 96‑deep‑well plate (e.g., OMNI 96‑Well Deep Well Plate with ceramic beads).

steps.title: Store or continue to part 2
steps.instruction: The 400 µL sample may be stored or used in part 2 of the protocol for purification.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definition
steps.instruction: If any labware is not already in the OT‑App library, upload its custom definition file.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Load the generated protocol bundle into the OT‑App.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map, placing tip racks, reservoirs, plates, and other required labware.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the OT‑App calibration routine to calibrate all labware and the p300 multi‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑App to start the automated workflow.
